linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: CentOS 7
  • Processor: Intel Core 2 Duo or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia Geforce 200
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: There may be graphical issues on Linux platforms, if that's the case, please use window resolution 1280x720 for better experience.
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 22.04
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics:
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: There may be graphical issues on Linux platforms, if that's the case, please use window resolution 1280x720 for better experience.
